text: KiraGetRS[{sec1, {gli1, ...}}] returns the number of positive and negative propagator powers (r and \(s\) in the Kira/Reduze syntax) for the GLI integrals belonging to sector sec1. The input can be also a list of such entries.

If the option Max is set to True (default), only the largest {r,s} combination made of the largest r and the largest s values in this sector will be returned. Otherwise, the function will return the {r,s}-pair for each GLI.
KiraGetRS can directly handle the output of FCLoopFindSectors. Furthermore, the function can also deal with a simple list of GLIs as in KiraGetRS[{gli1,gli2,...}].

If the option Top is set to True, and the input is a list of the form {{sec1, {gli11, ...}}, {sec2, {gli21, ...}}, ...} then the output will consists of a list of top sectors and the largest possible {r,s} combination.
KiraGetRS[{GLI[topo1, {1, 1, 1, 1}], GLI[topo1, {2, 1, 2, 1}], GLI[topo2, {1, 0, 1, 1}], GLI[topo3, {1, 0, 1, -1}]}, Max -> False]
